intro: Nogg is a goblin engineer operating out of a workshop in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. He offers tinkering expertise and specialized craftsmanship to the Horde, notably analyzing strange mechanical salvage recovered from deep within Gnomeregan.

p: Tucked away in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Nogg runs an independent engineering workshop catering to adventurers and craftsmen alike. While the surrounding city relies heavily on traditional orcish steel and brute strength, Nogg provides the specialized mechanical finesse that only a goblin can offer. He maintains a keen interest in foreign contraptions and tech, happily examining curious trinkets and mechanical oddities dragged back from Alliance lands or subterranean ruins.

Nogg takes special interest in items recovered from the fallen gnomish capital of Gnomeregan. When Horde operatives retrieve intricate rings or technological remnants from the irradiated vaults across the sea, Nogg is one of the few minds in Durotar capable of disassembling, deciphering, and retrofitting such bizarre clockwork mechanisms for Horde use.
